column1: # Message catalog of the flang compiler (ADR-0102).
# key: the FLANG_* code of a diagnostic, the name of a summary line (check.*, proof.*, place.*, ledger),
#      or {stem} for the vocabulary of a placeholder (the part of its name before a dot).
# ru: the Russian template, matched against what the compiler says; en: the English template.
# A placeholder is {name}: lowercase Latin letters, digits, '-' and '.'; both templates of a row name the same set.
